I have designed and delivered the new **/requests** page for the PSF Request Portal redesign project, adhering strictly to the approved **DESIGN.md** guidelines, component proportions, role specifications, and the exact PostgreSQL catalog snapshot.

### What Was Built:

1. **Purpose & Information Architecture (/requests):**
   - **Page Title & Subtitle**: Set to **"Requests"** with supporting copy *"Browse shared PSF requests."* and the explicit scope note *"• Private drafts are in My Drafts"*.
   - **No Dashboard Count Tiles or Role Scopes**: Completely omitted the Open/Overdue/Completed metric cards and the Owner department work scope toggle. The Requests view is a clean catalog of all submitted shared requests across GNTC and MFG.
   - **Navigation & User Context**:
     - Desktop sidebar rail with links to **Dashboard** (`/dashboard`), **Requests** (`/requests`, active), **My Drafts** (`/my-drafts`), **Audit History** (`/history`), and **Export** (`/admin/export-profile`).
     - Account header configured as fictional Requester **Sam Taylor** (`Requester · Systems Eng`) with avatar `ST`.
     - **New Request** CTA pointing to `/requests/new` for initial private draft creation.

2. **Clean Queue & Filtering Toolbar:**
   - Single horizontal bar on desktop with no KPI tiles, charts, or secondary rails:
     - **Search**: Labeled keyword search with placeholder `"Search request no., title, PSF or probecard"`.
     - **Status Selector**: Read-only filter containing `"All statuses"` and **all 16 non-draft catalog options** with exact punctuation, spacing, percentages, and literal backslashes preserved (including the full 71-character `93% -- Provide test template map to EWFM\Update auto FI script (ST Fab)`).
     - **Product Type Input**: Dedicated text input for filtering by product classification (`New Product`, `Transfer Product`, `Existing Product`).
     - **Clear Filters**: One-click filter reset returning to the full list.
   - Includes real local filtering logic on the 5 illustrative rows without mutating any underlying database records, complete with a helpful zero-state view when filters match none.

3. **Four-Column Queue Table & Five Verified Sample Rows:**
   - Four desktop columns: **Request**, **Status**, **Schedule**, and **Responsibility**.
   - Exactly the 5 requested illustrative records in specified sequence:
     1. **S32K3 probe layout update** (`PSF-2026-0042`, New Product) — `20% -- PSF File Creating` | High | Due 01 Oct 2026 (**Overdue**) | Alex Morgan | Mei Tan / MFG
     2. **ST Fab template map review** (`PSF-2026-0039`, Transfer Product) — `93% -- Provide test template map to EWFM\Update auto FI script (ST Fab)` | Normal | Due 06 Oct 2026 | Priya Rao | Rowan Miller / GNTC
     3. **Wafer map site verification** (`PSF-2026-0035`, Existing Product) — `99% -- Wait requestor Buyoff site location and wafer map` | Normal | Due 08 Oct 2026 | Alex Morgan | Mei Tan / MFG
     4. **Probe pattern release** (`PSF-2026-0028`, New Product) — `100% -- Completed` | Normal | Due 02 Oct 2026 | Jordan Lee | Rowan Miller / GNTC
     5. **Cancelled layout request** (`PSF-2026-0019`, Existing Product) — `0% -- Rejected (Cancel Request)` | Normal | Due 09 Oct 2026 | Priya Rao | Mei Tan / MFG
   - Status badges wrap cleanly across 2–3 lines, with category-based styling (open-work blue, completed green, cancelled muted gray).
   - Footer reflects the single-page contract: **"Showing 1–5 of 5 requests"** with disabled pagination buttons.

4. **Dual Light & Dark Theme Support (In-Screen Toggle):**
   - Implemented via semantic CSS variables adhering to the NXP-inspired palette (`#F4F7FA` light canvas / `#101B24` dark canvas; `#173248` ink / `#EDF4F8` dark text; `#006F95` primary action blue).
   - Working local vanilla JavaScript toggle button with accessible label (*"Switch to dark mode"* / *"Switch to light mode"*) located in the desktop sidebar footer and mobile header.

5. **Responsive Mobile Experience:**
   - Full collapsible drawer navigation for viewports under 900px, responsive card list view with identical 4 metadata groupings, and collapsible **Filter Options** disclosure.
